task.question: Can pinned public protein structure prediction repositories and small dataset samples form a reproducible source-cited native Tool/Workflow demo without running prediction models or silently promoting Agent proposals?

observations.statement: AlphaFold 2 repository publishes structure-prediction source code; code and parameter terms must be distinguished
OpenFold has protein FASTA and predicted-PDB examples in its repository, separate from large training datasets
ProteinNet documents standardized structure-training datasets; its GitHub README is not an actual CASP training corpus
CASP15 benchmark repository publishes predicted structures and scoring descriptions; prediction files are not independently re-scored in this pilot
AlphaFold 3 model weights have terms separate from the Apache-2.0 inference source code
ProteinGym addresses protein variant effects, a separate task from direct 3D structure prediction

proposed_changes.rationale: Separately reviewed pilot source registry with frozen commits, not automatic promotion into active weekly sources
Use native matching configuration for the scoped protein structure pilot without altering production topic IDs
Publish reproducibility, dataset separation, licensing and non-execution caveats

limitations: Observations are proposals pending independent source/data checks and normal PR review
GitHub objects include examples and benchmark predictions; full datasets may reside on external archives
Neither model weights nor inference are downloaded or executed
Prediction benchmark quality metrics will not be inferred from a PDB existence check
